j2b.58: The 1,008-token system prompt is already in the prefix cache (63 blocks). 202 tokens remain to prefill. In total 76 blocks are needed, of which 13 new ones are allocated. The token budget covers all the rest in this step.
j2b.59: The step’s tokens: 202 from this request + 1 from each of the 40 requests in decode. input_ids [242], positions [242], slot_mapping [242], query_start_loc [42], block tables.
j2b.60: Embedding [242, 4096] → 32 layers. In every layer: qkv_proj, RoPE, new K and V written to their slots, PagedAttention reading via block tables (including the 63 cached blocks), MLP.
j2b.61: Logits only for 41 positions, one per request: [41, 128256]. The sampler draws one token per request.
j2b.63: New tokens are detokenized incrementally, stop conditions are checked and the text is sent as SSE. The first token has arrived: TTFT is behind us.
j2b.65: The request now gets 1 token per step. Every 16th token needs a new KV block.
j2b.66: One row [1, 4096] for this request in a larger flattened batch. Attention reads 1,211, 1,212, … positions from the cache.
j2b.67: The model produces <|eot_id|>. The request is finished, the blocks are freed but stay in the prefix cache until the memory is needed.
